SOC 13-2011

Accountants and Auditors by metro

Among Austin, Chicago, and Seattle, Accountants and Auditors have a published OEWS May 2025 annual median of $99,370 in Seattle, the highest in this slice. Published medians: Seattle $99,370, Austin $83,120, Chicago $82,360.

Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, May 2025. bls.gov/oes. These figures are informational republications of BLS OEWS. They are not legal, career, or hiring advice.
